## Checks

- [ ] `ruff check custom_components tests scripts` and `python -m pytest` pass
- [ ] A test covers the change (the simulator in `tests/sim.py` can state the right answer)
- [ ] User-facing text is in English (`translations/en.json`) and the same keys exist in `pt-BR.json`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated if the change is user-visible
